name: What Garage Size Adds the Most Value?

mainEntity.name: What size garage addition adds the most resale value in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What size garage addition adds the most resale value in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resale value is not determined by size alone. In Los Angeles County, buyers often care about parking convenience, storage, curb appeal, and how well the garage fits the property. A well-designed one-car garage can add more practical value than a poorly placed larger garage that hurts yard space or looks out of proportion. In some neighborhoods, a two-car garage may be more desirable, especially where street parking is limited. However, a garage addition that overwhelms the lot or creates awkward access can reduce appeal. Contractors and homeowners should think about the broader property value effect, not just square footage. A smart design balances parking needs, storage, and exterior appearance so the addition feels like part of the home rather than an afterthought. For best results, the garage should match the home’s style and neighborhood expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The garage size that adds the most resale value usually depends on the neighborhood, parking scarcity, and whether the design fits the lot and home. In many areas, a functional one- or two-car garage with good storage and curb appeal is more valuable than an oversized garage that reduces yard space.
